Re-Imagining Security: AI & Threat Intelligence Drive Security Operations

Traditional security operations models are struggling to keep pace with cyber threats that are becoming faster, more sophisticated, and increasingly automated. Security teams today face overwhelming alert volumes, fragmented visibility, and adversaries that continuously evolve their tactics. To remain resilient, organizations must move beyond reactive defense and embrace AI-driven threat intelligence to create smarter, faster, and more adaptive security operations.

Join our webinar, “Re-Imagining Security: AI & Threat Intelligence Drive Security Operations,” led by Bryan Austin, Principal Detection and Response Engineer at Appalachian Security Services, for a strategic exploration of how AI and threat intelligence are transforming the modern Security Operations Center.

In this session, Bryan will examine how AI-powered threat intelligence is reshaping security operations by improving threat detection, accelerating incident response, reducing alert fatigue, and enabling proactive, intelligence-driven defense strategies.

Key Takeaways from This Webinar:

Don't miss this opportunity to gain practical and strategic insights into the future of intelligent security operations from a seasoned cybersecurity practitioner dedicated to making security operations more effective and adversaries less successful.

EC-Council | 101 C Sun Ave. NE, Albuquerque, NM 87109
Sent by connect@eccu.edu
